title: 55 to 70 character line length for reading
statement:
A medium line length of 55 to 70 characters per line provides the optimal balance for reading speed and comprehension, minimizing saccadic fatigue from returning to the start of new lines.

Options:
- Optimal Body Text: 55 - 75 characters per line (max-width: 65ch) (fits: blogs, news sites, documentation)
- Complex / Technical Reading: 45 - 55 characters per line (fits: academic journals, reference material)
- Mobile Layout / Columns: 35 - 45 characters per line (fits: mobile web, multi column news)
- Full-width Fluid (Avoid): 80+ characters per line (fits: data tables, code editors)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, desktop reading, tablet. Audience: general, adults, b2b buyers.

source.title: The influence of reading speed and line length on the effectiveness of reading from screen
